pluss::subsp::stats::ts::JohansenOptions¶

Options of ts::johansen_test.

JohansenOptions chooses the statistic and the deterministic terms of the cointegration test.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

lag_order

std::int64_t

1

Order p of the VAR in levels; p − 1 lagged differences are held fixed.

include_intercept

bool

true

An unrestricted constant (drift in the levels).

include_trend

bool

false

An unrestricted constant and linear trend.

statistic

ts::JohansenStat

Trace

Trace: tests rank ≤ r against any larger rank. MaxEigen: tests rank ≤ r against rank r + 1.

alpha

double

0.05

Significance level of the critical values and of reject.

Guidance¶

The p-values and critical values come from simulated limiting distributions for three specifications: no deterministic terms (both flags off), an unrestricted constant, and an unrestricted constant with a trend, for up to 12 series.
